cards.scope: Build additive ICP escrow accounting and backend API for ckSOL mint attempts
cards.evidenceText: Draft PR #610 head ac3b2d68: direct running-upgrade controls reproduced callback and cleanup traps; stop/drain and cancel-stop controls passed 3/3 in PocketIC, including an outstanding callback. The opt-in drained-upgrade wrapper passed seven mocked tests, two reviews, and real ICP CLI stop/upgrade/start on a disposable idle local canister with final hash verified. Other deployment paths are not enforced. Exact Rumi Arc stack remains unproven. Frontend CI and Stability Pool CI passed on the current head. No production action occurred; reserve remains off. Durable callback ABI exploration remains unimplemented: the minimal prototype agent was interrupted by an automated cybersecurity filter and produced no outcome. Tested stop/drain remains the practical mitigation; direct running upgrades remain unsafe.
